news.title: Rita Finance and Leasing Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 30 million in funding from Sellwin Traders Limited, Shilpa Buildcon Private Limited, Long View Financial Services Private Limited, Mideast Healthcare Pvt Ltd
news.body: Rita Finance and Leasing Limited has announced a private placement to issue 6,000,000 convertible warrants at the price of INR 5.00 for the gross proceeds of INR 30,000,000 on March 26, 2026. The transaction involves the new investor participation Sellwin Traders Limited for 790,000 warrants, Shilpa Buildcon Private Limited for 50,000 warrants, LongView Financial Services Pvt Ltd for 600,000 warrants, Mideast Healthcare Private Limited for 790,000 warrants and other individual investors. Each warrant holders to apply for and be allotted 1 equity share of the face value of INR 10 each of the Company for each warrant, within a period of 18 months from the date of allotment of the warrant. news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 9.4% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks No financial data reported. Share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months (9.4% average weekly change).
